outcome: detection of heart disease (CHD, Mild MS, Mild MR, Moderate MS, Moderate MR)
cohort: 200 asymptomatic pregnant women attending an Antenatal Outpatient Department (AN OPD) at Govt. Rajaji Hospital, Madurai.
finding: Screening echocardiography identified heart disease in 5.5% (11 out of 200) of asymptomatic pregnant women, with significant differences in valve area, LVEDD, and RAEDD observed between those with and without heart disease.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference between mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section) and the detected heart disease cases.
